headline: Horse-mounted ecological regeneration system among projects by IE University
context: Dezeen School Shows: a portable structure made from natural materials that disperses native seed types from horseback is among projects by IE University students. Also featured is a hospital interior scheme informed by greenhouses and a concept for a flood-adaptive interior layer

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a portable structure made from natural materials that disperses native seed types from horseback is among projects by IE University students. Also featured is a hospital interior scheme informed by greenhouses and a concept for a flood-adaptive interior layer that can be added to homes in flood-risk areas.
